essence: The great power is fully purified in all directions and radiantly manifest.
The mouth is ritually adorned with betel and musk.
A pair of vessels associated with yoginis and heroes is arranged separately.
The entire assembly is uniformly dressed in red and adorned with shining ornaments.
The kula teacher, in this complete form, is attended by the kula sons.
